title: review: H7 fix round 5: the pytest probe in the worktree carries a timeout, the environment marker list drops the bare tools/ substring, and the unused importlib.util import goes (review T-0424)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain the T-0364 lineage through 124c39e (T-0422) in git log; never drop or amend it.
Review T-0424 on T-0422, all three findings to address:
1. (high) orchestrator/daemon.py:163 the pytest-availability probe (uv run --project worktree python -c "import pytest") inside _flaky_rerun_command has no timeout, so a hang in uv or venv resolution blocks the single-threaded daemon loop; give the probe its own bounded timeout (a small fraction of [daemon].flaky_rerun_timeout_s, at least 30 s, or a dedicated [daemon].runner_probe_timeout_s default 60) and treat a probe timeout like an unavailable runner: no rerun, kind stays unknown, recorded in resume_hint. Test: tests/test_daemon.py::test_runner_probe_timeout_does_not_block_or_mark_flaky.
2. (med) orchestrator/daemon.py:180 the environment marker list contains the bare substring "tools/", which matches any traceback mentioning such a path and misclassifies a code defect as environment (skipping the automatic fix round). Remove it; keep markers that are specific (ModuleNotFoundError, No module named, ENOENT, command not found, missing venv, uv: error). Test: tests/test_daemon.py::test_tools_path_in_traceback_is_not_environment.
3. (low) remove the unused importlib.util import from daemon.py.
Keep every T-0364 lineage test green. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows 124c39e and the rest of the T-0364 lineage below your commit
grep shows the probe subprocess call carries a timeout, no tools/ marker in the environment list, and no importlib.util import in daemon.py
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
